text:
sophia: Heads-up — opened PR #4821 to central-config to enable runtime telemetry sampling. Touches runtime/ and infra/ paths in central-config. Who can approve this? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/central-config/pull/4821
kevin: looping in @maya and @jun since runtime + infra intersect. CODEOWNERS has /runtime/* -> @runtime-team and /infra/* -> @infra-team, but central-config is root-level so ownership is fuzzy.
maya: I can review the runtime bits, but I am not listed as a codeowner for root. Is it OK for me to approve the runtime part only? @eng-platform any precedence for split-approvals?
jun: This toggles telemetry flags that require an infra rollout plan. I want infra sign-off before merge. If infra is unavailable, who is authorized to proxy approve?
sophia: PR is tiny (3 files, default sampling change). CI is green. I'm trying to avoid the PR sitting blocked — but we shouldn't bypass infra. suggestions?
kevin: Policy-wise: codeowner listed people OR a manager can proxy approve small ops changes, but infra should be explicit for telemetry. If owners are ambiguous, add a short scoped exception comment in the PR and ping infra-oncall.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: CI status — checks passed (lint, unit tests). Org policy: 2 required reviews.
maya: I can leave a runtime review approval comment and address any runtime-specific inline notes. Can't merge without infra + meeting review count.
jun: I'll ping infra-oncall and do the infra review. If infra-oncall is slow, we can escalate to a scheduler, but prefer an infra reviewer.
sophia: OK I'll add label "needs-infra-approval" and ping infra-oncall in-thread. If no infra response within 24h, can @kevin escalate to a documented proxy approver?
kevin: I'll prepare a follow-up tiny PR to add /central-config/* owners (adding @maya and @jun) to reduce future ambiguity, and I'll act as escalation proxy for this change if both runtime+infra reviews are present in thread and an engineering manager signs off. @maya can you +1 the runtime review here?
maya: +1 runtime review. Left one inline comment about default sampling value, fine to ship after that tweak.
jun: infra-oncall: pinged. Will review infra side in the hour and add rollback/runbook notes if needed.
sophia: tagging infra-oncall: @infra-oncall please take a look: https://github.com/redwood-inference/central-config/pull/4821
infra-oncall: infra-oncall: reviewed — infra approves. Small rollout playbook update required, created follow-up issue #2560. No blocking infra changes.
sophia: Awesome — merging in ~10m unless anyone objects. Thanks everyone :tada:
